# Record Helpers

## Summary
Three helpers the service-desk commands share. `loaded(context, card)` re-fetches a card before a command reads through its links, because a card handed across a command boundary (a queue row, a search result) may have links that were never loaded, and reading one yields `undefined` and the command quietly does the wrong thing. `loadedById(context, id)` does the same from an id. `displayTitle(card, fallback)` is the one title fallback chain (`cardTitle`, then `title`) for command messages and row labels.

## Usage
```ts
import { loaded, displayTitle } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/record-helpers';

let fresh = await loaded(this.commandContext, input.case);
return `Resolved ${displayTitle(fresh)}`;
```

## Non-goals
No caching: every call re-fetches.
